draft.name: MATII Data & AI Platform

listing.title: AI & data platform
listing.description: Practical AI and connected data that turn information into informed action.

draft.headline: Put your data to work.
draft.description: MATII Data & AI enables organizations to connect their data, understand it, analyze it, build AI applications on top of it, and put those applications into production under enterprise security and governance.
draft.portfolioDescription: Explore every layer: data integration and governance, analytics and machine learning, model serving and AI applications, all brought together in MATII Studio.

products.name: MATII Connect
products.description: Connect data from databases, APIs, files, applications, and streaming systems.
capabilities: PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQL Server, and other database connectors
CSV, Excel, JSON, Parquet, and document ingestion

products.name: MATII Lakehouse
products.description: Store and process large volumes of structured and unstructured data.
capabilities: Open table formats such as Apache Iceberg
Separate raw, cleaned, and curated data zones

products.name: MATII Catalog
products.description: Help organizations discover, understand, trust, and govern their data.
capabilities: Access policies, retention, and audit trails

products.name: MATII Analytics
products.description: Turn governed data into useful business information.

products.name: MATII Knowledge
products.description: Organize relationships across enterprise data and documents.

products.name: MATII ML
products.description: Build, train, evaluate, and deploy predictive models.
capabilities: Feature engineering and reusable feature stores
Model evaluation, drift detection, and monitoring

products.name: MATII Models
products.description: Make AI models accessible through consistent, secure APIs.
capabilities: Rate limits, quotas, and usage metering
Latency, token usage, and cost tracking

products.name: MATII Agents
products.description: Build AI assistants and agents that perform useful, permission-controlled work.

products.name: MATII Studio
products.description: Bring data engineers, analysts, data scientists, and AI developers together.

process.title: Find the use case
process.description: Review your data and choose a problem where AI can make a useful difference.

process.title: Prove the approach
process.description: Test a focused prototype for accuracy, usefulness, and safety.

process.title: Build for production
process.description: Connect data pipelines, deploy models, and validate the complete workflow.

process.title: Evaluate & improve
process.description: Monitor output quality and refine the system as your data and needs evolve.

faqs.question: Is our proprietary company data used to train public AI models?
faqs.answer: Never. All AI pipelines, RAG systems, and fine-tuned models run inside your private, isolated virtual private cloud (VPC) with strict zero-retention API contracts.

faqs.question: Can your AI agents safely interact with our existing internal APIs?
faqs.answer: Yes. Our autonomous agent frameworks execute tool calls inside sandboxed environments with strict schema validation, deterministic fallback logic, and human approval gates.

faqs.question: How do you evaluate and prevent hallucinations in production RAG systems?
faqs.answer: We deploy multi-stage verification pipelines including citation attribution checks, ground-truth hallucination scoring, and cross-encoder re-ranking before delivering answers to users.

overview.positioning: A strategic product of MATII Technologies, designed for banks, government institutions, telecoms, large enterprises, and developers.
overview.example: Imagine a bank with customer records in PostgreSQL, transactions in another system, documents stored as PDFs, reports in Excel, and internal policies spread across files. MATII Data & AI brings these sources into a connected, governed environment.
overview.applications: The same platform can support a government institution analyzing census data, a telecom company forecasting demand, or a corporation automating document-heavy processes.
workflow: Build a searchable, governed view of your information.
Analyze operations through dashboards and natural-language queries.
Build AI assistants that answer questions using authorized information.
Develop predictive models and deploy AI services.
Monitor accuracy, cost, access, and performance in production.

draft.name: BPO Solutions

listing.title: BPO solutions
listing.description: Dedicated people and dependable processes that give your team room to grow.

draft.headline: Give your team room to grow.
draft.description: Keep your business moving with dedicated support teams, dependable back-office operations, and technology that makes everyday work easier.
draft.outcome: The right people. A smoother operation.
draft.portfolioDescription: Explore customer support, back-office operations, data services, and dedicated teams. Choose the expertise you need to keep work moving and give your team room to grow.

products.name: Customer & technical support
products.description: Support your customers across channels and languages, with coverage shaped around their needs.
capabilities: Omnichannel Customer Experience (CX): 24/7 live chat, voice, email, and social customer support managed by dedicated, brand-trained customer success specialists delivering empathetic and rapid resolutions.
Multilingual 24/7 Technical Support: Around-the-clock software troubleshooting, hardware ticketing, developer API support, and bug triage in English, Polish, German, and major global languages.

products.name: Back-office operations
products.description: Keep essential administration, reconciliation, and reporting running consistently.
capabilities: Technical Back-Office Operations: Complex workflow execution, tier-2 account verifications, KYC/AML identity checks, exception handling, and enterprise claims processing.
Financial Reconciliation & Auditing Pods: Meticulous invoice matching, payment disputes handling, ledger balancing, and merchant settlement investigations executing with zero margin for error.

products.name: Data processing & annotation
products.description: Turn raw information into structured, quality-checked data for your business and AI teams.
capabilities: AI Training Data Processing & Annotation: High-precision human-in-the-loop data labeling, RLHF prompt evaluation, multilingual translation QA, and visual object segmentation for AI engineering teams.

products.name: Dedicated talent teams
products.description: Extend your team with people trained in your tools, workflows, and standards.
capabilities: Dedicated Talent & Team Augmentation: Exclusive, full-time specialist squads aligned with your timezone, culture, and toolchain—seamlessly managed with daily telemetry and KPI dashboards.

process.title: Map the work
process.description: Understand your workflows and agree on service and quality expectations.

process.title: Build your team
process.description: Select and train people around your systems and customer experience.

process.title: Start together
process.description: Shadow your team and transition work gradually with quality checks.

process.title: Keep improving
process.description: Review performance together and refine the operation as needs change.

faqs.question: How do you ensure data security and customer privacy?
faqs.answer: All operations are conducted on secure, access-controlled virtual desktop infrastructures with strict DLP (Data Loss Prevention) rules, zero local storage, and full SOC 2 / GDPR compliance.

faqs.question: How quickly can a dedicated BPO pod be deployed?
faqs.answer: Standard pods can be fully onboarded, trained on your custom SOPs, and operating in production within 14 business days.

faqs.question: Can we scale pod headcount up or down based on seasonal demand?
faqs.answer: Yes. Our agile operational contracts provide dynamic elasticity, allowing you to scale up for peak seasons and scale down during normalized periods.

draft.name: Managed Cloud

listing.title: Managed cloud services
listing.description: Reliable infrastructure, smoother releases, and support for what comes next.

draft.headline: A stronger foundation for what comes next.
draft.description: Move, manage, and improve your cloud infrastructure with a team focused on reliability, security, and keeping your business running.
draft.portfolioDescription: Explore cloud migration, managed operations, delivery automation, and resilience. Build a connected foundation for your applications, with security and cost visibility throughout.

products.name: Cloud architecture & migration
products.description: Plan your cloud environment and move workloads in manageable, carefully tested stages.
capabilities: Multi-Cloud Architecture & Migration: Seamless architectural design and zero-downtime workload migration across AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure tailored for regulatory and sovereignty requirements.

products.name: Managed operations
products.description: Monitor services, manage incidents, and keep infrastructure maintained with dedicated support.
capabilities: 24/7/365 Site Reliability Engineering (SRE): Continuous telemetry monitoring, automated anomaly detection, synthetic user health checks, and rapid remediation protocols preventing production outages before they impact users.

products.name: DevOps & delivery automation
products.description: Make releases repeatable with automated pipelines, containers, and infrastructure as code.
capabilities: Kubernetes & Container Orchestration: Production-grade EKS, GKE, and bare-metal Kubernetes topologies configured with Istio service mesh, auto-scaling horizontal pods, and zero-trust mTLS network policies.

GitOps & Automated CI/CD Rails: Declarative Infrastructure as Code (IaC) with Terraform, automated canary deployment validation, automated rollback triggers, and comprehensive security vulnerability scanning.

products.name: Cost, security & resilience
products.description: Review spending, strengthen access controls, and prepare backup and recovery plans.
capabilities: FinOps & Cloud Cost Optimization: Deep architectural auditing, spot instance optimization, resource right-sizing, and reservation commitments reducing unnecessary cloud expenditures by 30% to 50%.
Disaster Recovery & Data Resilience: Active-active and active-passive multi-region database replication, immutable off-site backups, and automated failover tests delivering near-zero RPO and RTO.

process.title: Assess
process.description: Review your infrastructure, costs, performance, and security needs.

process.title: Plan
process.description: Design the target environment and agree on the migration approach.

process.title: Migrate & validate
process.description: Move workloads progressively and test reliability before switching over.

process.title: Manage & improve
process.description: Monitor operations and regularly review costs, patches, and performance.

faqs.question: Do we retain full ownership of our cloud accounts?
faqs.answer: Absolutely. All infrastructure is deployed directly into your own AWS, GCP, or Azure organizational accounts. You retain 100% root ownership and access keys.

faqs.question: How does your team handle 2am critical production incidents?
faqs.answer: Our global SRE team operates follow-the-sun 24/7/365 monitoring. Automated alert triggers page dedicated tier-3 engineers with a guaranteed 5-minute response SLA.

faqs.question: Can Matii assist with compliance audits like SOC 2 or HIPAA on cloud environments?
faqs.answer: Yes. We configure automated compliance policies, IAM least-privilege roles, audit logs, and encryption at rest/transit to pass SOC 2, ISO 27001, and HIPAA audits.

draft.name: Enterprise Software

listing.title: Enterprise software
listing.description: Connected platforms and business-critical systems, built around your operations.

draft.headline: Software built around your business.
draft.description: From core banking to everyday operations, we design and build reliable platforms that connect your systems and grow with your business.
draft.portfolioHeading:
Connected systems.
Built around your business.
draft.portfolioDescription: Explore the foundations of your enterprise software: financial platforms, business operations, secure integrations, and modernization, shaped around your existing systems.

products.name: Banking & financial platforms
products.description: Connect payments, accounts, settlement, and reporting in systems built for your financial workflows.
capabilities: Core Banking & Financial Settlement: High-throughput transactional ledgers, real-time settlement rails, multi-currency wallets, and regulatory reporting systems engineered for tier-1 financial institutions.

products.name: Custom business software
products.description: Bring inventory, logistics, billing, and resource planning together around the way your team works.
capabilities: Enterprise ERP & Operations Backbones: Bespoke resource management engines that unify supply chains, cross-border logistics, inventory forecasting, and corporate billing into cohesive microservices.

products.name: APIs & system integration
products.description: Connect applications and data through secure APIs and services that work together.
capabilities: Distributed Microservices & Event Meshes: Zero-downtime, independently scalable service clusters orchestrated across event-driven message backbones with Kafka, NATS, and gRPC contracts.
Zero-Trust API Ingress & Gateways: Cryptographically verified API perimeter security, automated token validation, mTLS inter-service encryption, and dynamic threat mitigation.

products.name: Legacy modernization
products.description: Upgrade existing software in stages, with security, audit trails, and continuity built into the plan.
capabilities: Legacy Monolith Modernization: Strangler-fig pattern system rewrites and transactional database migrations ensuring continuous operations with zero user-facing service interruptions.
Auditability & Immutable Cryptographic Trails: Tamper-proof chronological state history logging, append-only verification trees, and automated compliance reporting ready for institutional audits.

process.title: Understand
process.description: Map your workflows, existing systems, and business requirements.

process.title: Design
process.description: Define the architecture, integrations, and a practical delivery roadmap.

process.title: Build & test
process.description: Deliver in focused sprints, with testing and feedback at every stage.

process.title: Launch & support
process.description: Prepare for production, monitor performance, and improve as you grow.

faqs.question: How do you guarantee zero downtime during core platform upgrades?
faqs.answer: We utilize blue/green deployments, automated canary routing, and the strangler-fig pattern with backward-compatible database schemas to ensure migrations happen without service disruption.

faqs.question: Can Matii's enterprise software integrate with our existing legacy databases?
faqs.answer: Yes. We regularly build high-performance change-data-capture (CDC) pipelines and abstraction layers that connect modern microservices with legacy systems like AS/400, Oracle, and mainframes.

faqs.question: What compliance standards do your systems adhere to?
faqs.answer: Our software engineering standards comply with PCI-DSS Level 1, SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001, GDPR, and HIPAA data privacy mandates.
